{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Inspect the data
print(df.info())
print('\nFirst few rows:')
print(df.head())

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
print(f"\nNumber of -999 in biomarker_baseline: {df['biomarker_baseline'].eq(-999).sum()}")

# Check for duplicate patient_id
print(f"\nNumber of duplicate patient_id entries: {df['patient_id'].duplicated().sum()}")

# Check assay_batch values
print(f"\nUnique assay_batch values: {df['assay_batch'].unique()}")

# Check sample_seq distribution
print(f"\nMax sample_seq: {df['sample_seq'].max()}")

# Check for missing values in biomarker_final
print(f"\nMissing values in biomarker_final: {df['biomarker_final'].isnull().sum()}")"}
